scope: Independent read-only semantic and provenance review of selected RIPEMD160, SHA512 and HMAC round2 candidates; narrow independent HMAC ABI differential execution.

ripemd160: Length, header, reserved bytes, count cap, unused tail and pre-first-block IV validate before offsets or short update fast path.
Short update condition is strictly input length <64-used, so exact block completion enters compression; checked total precedes return.
Pinned public CoreProxy/Buffer APIs preserve total/64 core counter and total%64 pending bytes without transmuting Rust layouts.
Immediate init stores cover all104bytes, use unaligned portable little-endian stores and preserve the IV.
sha512: Pinned generic-array representation permits alignment1 immutable complete-block views. len/128 bounds multiplication and references do not escape.
Word-tail scan includes every remainder byte; length<2^125 prevents bit-count overflow; zero writes still validate.
Direct state serialization covers0..216 and digest writes exactly48/64bytes with portable big-endian words.
Padding at111/112 and127/128 follows baseline; partial-tail invariant remains zero beyond count%128.
hmac: Short-circuit word-tail validation rejects any nonzero full word or remainder byte without overread.
Key ipad construction and repeated-byte xor to opad preserve short and hashed-long-key behavior.
Full-block batching uses pinned GenericArray representation/size/alignment; immutable slices cannot escape.
Direct-state stores cover0..136 and0..272 exactly; count byte temporary lives through copy; input-state fields are owned before output writes.
Counter limits and canonical unused tails retained; new/decode/update preserve zeros.
wrappers: All three compiler generators and public modules hash-identical to baseline.
Fresh managed Blob allocation precedes payload pointer extraction, with no further allocation/safepoint before synchronous kernel callback.

coverage: Differently poisoned whole-output comparisons against baseline
Guard canaries and immutable input/state checks
own_execution.source_adaptation: Private copies remove only no_mangle export annotations to coexist. No shared implementation edits.

limitations: Did not repeat broad SHA512/RIPEMD native suites; reviewed exact-source reports and independently inspected implementation.
Own canaries detect overwritten bounds, not protected-page overreads; other independent auditors cover sanitizer/guard-page tests.
Benchmark methodology and final combined build belong to parent audit/orchestrator.
